Functions.Original: static inline int Prs_CharIsDigit( char c )   { return (c >= '0' && c <= '9');                                                      }
Functions.Draft: func Prs_CharIsDigit(c byte) int32 { return (c >= '0' && c <= '9');                                                      }

Functions.Name: Prs_CharIsDigitB
